newsitem.title: USA: Anacomp Q4 net loss $17.6 mln.
newsitem.headline: Anacomp Q4 net loss $17.6 mln.

text.p: Anacomp Inc said on Wednesday for it reported a net loss of $17.6 million in the fourth quarter, compared to a net loss of $92.7 million in the same quarter of the prior year.

The fourth quarter 1996 loss included a $19.2 non-cash reorganization amortization, the company said. Anacomp restructured financially and emerged from Chapter 11 of the U.S. Bankruptcy Code during fiscal 1996.
Due to restructuring and Fresh Start Reporting requirements, Anacomp said it recorded a "reorganization value" asset totalling $267.3 million, to be amortized over three and a half years.
This non-cash charge would likely result in net losses during that period, the company said.

For the year ended September 30, 1996, the company reported net income of $142.4 million on revenues of $486.1 million compared to a loss of $240.5 million on revenues of $591.2 million in the prior fiscal year.

Because Anacomp was recapitalized upon emerging from Chapter 11 with the issuance of new common stock, earnings per share are not comparable, the company said. In the recent fourth quarter, Anacomp earned $1.76 per share.
The company said much of the year-to-date improvement was due to disposition of unprofitable or non-strategic products and services as well as substantial reduction in expenses.

Fiscal 1996 results also included a gain of $145.3 million related to the restructuring and debt forgiveness, and fiscal 1995 results included $175.6 million of special, restructuring and refinancing charges.
